value: Shrinking Game: Small life is hard!
シュリンキング～小さくなって大ハード～

Miniguy exploration game with minimal RPG elements. Explore a highschool filled with Shivharu’s original characters. 
(Tip: The black screen image in the english version is not loaded properly. Create a duplicate of the black screen image inside the pictures folder and name it “黒画面.png” to avoid a loading bug)
You wake up shrunk to 3cm inside of a highschool, and have to find 10 hidden items in order to return to your normal size. Girls you encounter mistake you for a bug and attempt to trample you.
